revisions.name: $handle_DispatchMessageA
revisions.reason: Review 20261127 NULL-window TIMERPROC: move the ordinary NULL-hwnd no-op below the existing WM_TIMER/nonzero-lParam callback branch. Public SetTimer(NULL) callbacks now use the same guest stack args, original caller return address, EIP target and steps reset as window TIMERPROC; no new callback frame or lifetime is introduced. Ordinary NULL messages, NULL WM_TIMER without callback and multimedia callback routing retain their existing behavior. Ownership remains pending; no nonlocal API enabled.
